title: Data Quest
note: Subject v2.0. argv/stdin exercises are compared to the subject line by line ("mimic the example": other wording is a warning, the values and the number of lines must match). The random ones (achievements, stream, alchemist) are parsed back (achievements: run with a fixed random seed, so the result is the same on every run; an empty set is a valid draw) (other labels are a warning) and recomputed (union, intersection, removals, average...). Source: authorized builtins (str/int/float for the whole module, each collection type once its exercise introduced it), allowed imports only, no open() ("No file I/O operations are allowed"), type hints, flake8, mypy.
